interpretation_boundary: Embedding and counterfactual results are literal set-cover and direct-reference measurements. The forbid-I72 result is exact infeasibility. The forbid-other-additions result is infeasible because at least one frontier identity has no available local candidate after exclusion; the previously reported 309 was an inherited unconstrained baseline, not a constrained feasible cover. These results do not establish semantic composition or causal necessity.

falsifier.question: Is the inserted 72-interface block literally the standalone block, and do counterfactual exclusions alter coverability?
